records.public_safe_text: police responded to the listed location for a major accident involving a pedestrian. upon arrival officers were on scene gathering information and the pedestrian (unit 2) was found deceased on arrival. i spoke with unit 1 driver who stated that he was [roadway] [roadway] and was proceeding through [roadway]. unit 1 driver stated that he observed [roadway] and attempted to swerve to avoid [roadway]. unit 1 driver stated that he was unable to avoid hitting unit 2 who, [roadway] while unit 2's light was red, to proceed through the intersection. unit 1 driver stated that he clipped unit 2's wheelchair causing him to fall off the wheelchair onto the ground. unit 1 driver stated that unit 3 was approaching the intersection and struck unit 2 after he fell off the wheelchair. unit 1 driver stated that it was dark and that unit 3 probably did not see unit 2 in the roadway. unit 3 driver stated that she was traveling westbound on sw military also, and was going through the intersection at s flores because she had a green light. unit 3 driver stated that she did not see anything in the roadway but felt a large bump in the roadway. unit 3 driver stated that she looked back and saw it was a body so she immediately pulled over to see what occurred. witnesses nearby stated that unit 2 had just gotten off the via bus at the corner of [roadway]. witnesses stated that unit 1 appeared confused and stated that [roadway] (east) to get onto the other side of s flores but he stopped [roadway] going north across sw military. witnesses stated that unit 2 crossed the roadway when traffic going [roadway] had a green light. witnesses stated that unit 2 was struck by unit 1, then struck by unit 3. unit 1 driver complained of pain to his leg. all parties involved were shaken up due to the accident. all parties remained on scene until traffic investigations made the location to investigate. supervisor was notified. medical examiner was notified. unit 2 was not identified at this time. coban and bwc are available. **this report was supplemented on [date] by det. p. davis #2406 to reflect the toxicology results for unit 2. unit 2's blood alcohol level was 0. 184 g/dl and his blood was positive for methamphetamine 0. 22 mg/l.**
